claims.claim_text: The indexed Vincent DeSanto is confirmed as the Army entrant recorded as Vincent De Santo and the sergeant interviewed at Caserta.

claims.temporal_assessment: The caption establishes wartime OSS training but supplies no pre-OSS employer or recruitment chronology.
